thread:
riya: SIEM flagged unusual KMS Decrypt activity for our backup CMK tied to archived artifact. posting path and starting containment.
marc: path? i'll pull CloudTrail + S3 access logs.
riya: s3://redwood-retention/2023-07/backup_state.enc
marc: CloudTrail shows 3 Decrypt events and 2 GetObject within last 24h. principals: ci-runner-old and partner-ingest-role. exporting events to incident bucket.
devops-oncall: immediate containment: deny Decrypt in CMK policy for partner-ingest-role, freeze writes to that S3 prefix, enable object-level logs to secure-audit for 7d.
sec-bot: matched "keystore-contain" playbook. recommended flow: emergency key-policy deny -> issue new CMK -> swap alias -> rewrap via Vault transit -> rotate implicated roles -> enable SIEM hooks.
riya: marc, can you author infra PR to create replacement CMK and swap alias? tag me for review.
marc: yes. PR will also add conditional deny for external IP ranges. estimating 20m maintenance window.
vault-bot: suggested Vault commands: 
# create new transit key
vault write -f transit/keys/backup-2025-rot1
# rewrap ciphertext (example)
vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=@backup_state.enc key=backup-2025-rot1
riya: we'll rewrap all artifacts in that prefix. tldr: partner entitlement revoked on transit key until validated.
devops-oncall: scheduling maintenance at 22:45 UTC for 25m. posting notice to #deployments and #customers-incident where needed.
marc: infra PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1220 - creates CMK, swaps alias, and patches key policy to deny partner principal.
sec-bot: checklist: CMK swap: in-progress; Vault rewrap: pending; role rotation: pending; SIEM alert tuning: in-progress.
marc: discovered stale CI token in artifact metadata; rotating all tokens minted before 2025-01-01. will coordinate owners.
riya: enabling vault audit forwarder to SIEM with high priority and adding rule to open a PagerDuty incident on decrypt by non-admin identities.
vault-bot: rewrap job started for prefix, reporting progress every 10m.
devops-oncall: confirm: old CMK alias disabled, new alias points to replacement key. scheduling old key for scheduled-destroy in 30 days per policy.
marc: infra merge complete; ci-runner-old role rotated; pipelines rekeyed.
vault-bot: rewrap completed for items in prefix; partner grant removed from transit key; audit-hook confirmed in SIEM.
riya: drafting short partner/customer note: "We identified activity involving an archived, encrypted backup. Keys and access were rotated and controls tightened. No confirmed exfiltration." saving to incident-docs.
sec-bot: queued follow-ups: RBAC audit, KMS policy hardening, credential churn report, postmortem.
riya: thanks team. reply here with DONE when your assigned item is closed and i'll file remediation tickets. :thumbsup:
